canDoYue: 你識用口講跟進同附件，仲識確認期限。
canDoEn: Say a follow-up, mention an attachment, and confirm a deadline.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨 Tom，我今日跟進我已經寄出、關於期限嗰封電郵。
dialogue.say: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝你跟進，我感激你按討論咁附上筆記。
dialogue.say: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.
dialogue.glossYue: 我已經按討論附上份文件，想同你講清楚個期限。
dialogue.say: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time today?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以講清楚個期限，同埋今日確認一個新時間？
dialogue.say: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time today?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.
dialogue.glossYue: 我提議星期五做新期限，你有空我就確認時間。
dialogue.say: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期五有空，我已經睇過你今朝附上嘅文件。
dialogue.say: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.
dialogue.glossYue: 我感激你咁快覆，我會書面確認星期五個期限。
dialogue.say: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.
dialogue.glossYue: 暫時祝好，你確認期限之後我期待你份筆記。
dialogue.say: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.
